mismatches.reason: The predicate makes the no-revert guarantee conditional on a ZeroCostTrade revert already occurring, which does not encode the intent that legitimate matches must not revert.
The statement is about scope covering all partial and full matches, but the predicate asserts a ZeroCostTrade revert together with disjoint bits, encoding a different fact.
I is vacuously satisfied when no revert occurs and V asserts a revert, so V does not contradict I under P and the intended violation is not captured.
